description: Make a group of projects, rename one or delete one. 'group' names it (its name, any case, or its id); a name the company has no group by makes one. 'rename' gives an existing group a new name; 'delete': true removes it — its projects stay, in no group, and the people put in it by hand leave it. The company's administrator only; every change is in the company's journal.

group.description: The group's name, e.g. 'Client A', or its id.

rename.description: A new name for an existing group.

name: set_project_group
title: Set project group
